disambiguation: Not just a note-taking tool, it is an environment for building and running autonomous AI agents.
extras: All agent data, tasks, and memory are stored locally as Markdown files in the vault. Secrets are stored in the OS keychain.
intentEvidence: Turn your vault into an AI command center.
problem: It addresses the difficulty of running complex, autonomous AI workflows and managing agent interactions within a local, Markdown-based knowledge base.
summary: Agent Fleet allows users to build and run autonomous AI agents directly within their Obsidian vault using various CLI backends like Claude Code and OpenAI Codex.
